source: independent judge (grok, disposable worktree, no access to the verdict file)
why: Judge verdicts are otherwise written by the same agent that wrote the code. This run exists to produce dissent that self-review structurally cannot.
adjudication: ADJUDICATED — all four FAILs verified by hand against the source and confirmed real; all four fixed.

verdicts.note: Checked summarize (summary.ts:176-196), ruleLane/groupRulesByLane (58-84), formatRelativeTime (relativeTime.ts:7-30), Home state switch (Home.tsx:21-56), and RunList meta assembly (RunList.tsx:159-163). Helpers are short plain pipelines; no dense one-liners that need a comment to decode.

Named pieces have production callers: RunDetailBody (RunDetail.tsx:294-301) is rendered by RunDetail (378-381); KpiStrip/StatusBadge are used from Home/RunList/RunDetail; useDrawerA11y is a re-export of design-system (useDrawerA11y.ts:8-13). No test-only duals with zero production callers; BackToRunsLink (307-312) is used on three recovery paths (350, 361, 373).

Untrusted feed is validated with hand-rolled typeof checks in parseRun/parseRunsFeed (summary.ts:128-169) and consumed at useRuns.ts:38. The monorepo already standardizes Zod (app-builder submit.ts; orchestrator RunResultSchema at results.ts:3-72 with range/refine checks). dashboard/package.json:13-17 has no zod, so the app reimplements weaker schema logic instead of the existing library/schema. Shell correctly uses design-system (shell/styles.ts:3,65; useDrawerA11y.ts:8-13) — that does not rescue the feed boundary.
verdicts.adjudicationNote: Correct: the feed was validated by a hand-rolled typeof chain while the monorepo standardises on Zod at every other boundary. Migrated to Zod; the dashboard now depends on zod directly.

verdicts.note: Git was not run (task forbids it). Judged product surface: App.tsx:15-22 routes are list/detail plus required legal pages; functions/ only health.ts; no drive-by features, auth scaffolding, or unrelated data layers beyond the read-only runs feed.

The only untrusted input is the cross-origin results feed (useRuns.ts:34-39). Boundary validation is parseRunsFeed/parseRun (summary.ts:128-169): typeof field checks only — no Zod/safeParse, and dashboard has no zod dependency (package.json:13-17). parseRun accepts any number scores, any finishedAt string, empty rules, and no passed↔score coherence; RunResultSchema (orchestrator/src/schemas/results.ts:47-66) already enforces those. Route slug is only decodeURIComponent + find (RunDetail.tsx:320-321,366) with no schema. No request-body handlers exist, but the feed still reaches UI logic without the required schema library.
verdicts.adjudicationNote: Correct, and it contradicted the GATE, which had marked this rule n/a for the dashboard on the grounds that it takes no input. The cross-origin results feed IS untrusted input. Rule broadened to cover client reads of cross-origin JSON; validation migrated to Zod.

verdicts.note: No auth surface to stub: functions/ only health.ts (real JSON + CORS headers, lines 1-12). Grep of dashboard for TODO/FIXME/stub security markers finds none in app code. Feed path fails closed on HTTP/parse errors (useRuns.ts:36-51; parseRun throws at summary.ts:129-145) rather than bypassing checks.

Public branches with zero assertions: useRuns timeout/HTTP/parse error paths (useRuns.ts:36-51) have no test file; Home loading/error/empty (Home.tsx:21-47) untested; RunDetail loading/error/missing-slug/not-found (RunDetail.tsx:334-375) untested — RunDetail.test.ts only mounts RunDetailBody (export noted 'for tests' at 292-293). formatRelativeTime months/years (relativeTime.ts:25-29) have no cases in relativeTime.test.ts (only justNow/m/h/d + invalid). Parser/list/KPI suites do not cover these product branches.
verdicts.adjudicationNote: Correct: useRuns.ts had no test file at all, including the timeout branch added earlier the same day. Logic extracted to fetchRuns and covered by six tests (success, non-2xx, malformed feed, non-array feed, abort-as-timeout, transport failure).

verdicts.note: en.test.ts asserts presence via length > 2 for menu/titles/KPI/headings (en.test.ts:76-77,88-93,101-105) — the anti-pattern the rule calls out — rather than exact copy or rendered behaviour. Core error branches of the product (useRuns timeout/error at useRuns.ts:41-51; RunDetail error/not-found at RunDetail.tsx:344-375) are never exercised; tests only render the pure body (RunDetail.test.ts:5-8,22) so the suite does not assert the fail-closed UI behaviour the pages implement.
verdicts.adjudicationNote: Correct: 12 length>2 presence assertions in en.test.ts. Replaced with exact copy plus distinctness properties. The exact assertions immediately caught two values that had been guessed wrong.
